contents.text: A possessive noun shows who or what owns something or has something.

header.text: To form the possessive of a compound noun, make the last part of the noun possessive.
When two nouns joined by and share possession of something, only the second noun should be written as a possessive noun.

header.text: When two nouns joined by and do not share possession of something, both nouns should be written as possessive nouns.
